VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The acceptance criteria explicitly requires that "all 72 tests pass," which is a verifiable, objective requirement. The agent's self-report claims this was achieved, but provides no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, diffs, or artifacts) to substantiate the claim. Self-reports alone cannot satisfy acceptance criteria that demand demonstrable proof of test passage. The absence of CI logs or test results means the claim cannot be independently verified.
